conventions.transcriptLocator: stage N transcript HH:MM:SS is the start of the fragment on the transcript's own clock
conventions.speakers: In both transcripts 'Me' is the candidate. 'Dagny' is Dagny Holmqvist in stage 1 and Dagny Ferreira-Lund in stage 2.
conventions.deviceOnly: The stage 2 transcript is device-only: nothing in it may be given to a reader that does not run on the machine.

cases.what: Absent from every source: GraphQL, Kafka, Terraform, Nix, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, PHP, Azure, Jaeger, Datadog, Helm, Airflow, Neovim, Swift, machine learning. Absent although they share common words with the material: React (the transcript only has Dagny saying 'you can react to it' at 13:20:15); writing a Kubernetes operator; HTTP cache-control headers or CDN caching; data pipelines and ETL (every 'pipeline' here is a CI pipeline); distributed transactions (only distributed tracing and distributed compilation exist); a JetBrains plugin written by the candidate (JetBrains is only the employer's product; her extension was for VS Code); ClickHouse at Marrowgate (only at Quillhaven); Rust in paid work (Tracewright is unpaid); Windows build agents (only in posting-edited.txt, as a requirement, with no candidate evidence); Spanforge's revenue or the Enterprise share of it (the notes plan to ask; nobody answers); the candidate's current salary; remote work policy at Quillhaven; Gradle build scans (Gradle appears only at Driftline and in Spanforge's supported tools).
cases.expect: The reader says the material does not contain it; no evidence is invented and no near-match is passed off as an answer.
